authorReview.scope: Complete eight-sentence script checked against canonical short-reader opening evidence for premise, clear identity, specific interest and protected revelations.
authorReview.targetDuration: About one minute at an unhurried conversational pace with real pauses; measure after recording.
authorReview.emotion: Concrete recognition, thoughtful tension and open curiosity; no melodramatic mystery or inflated promise.
authorReview.audioConversion: Blocked until all batch scripts pass independent editorial review.

independentReview.notes: Every spoken sentence reviewed against canonical English short reader for clear newcomer meaning, source grounding, curiosity and emotional intent. Replaced abstract promotional commentary with concrete viewer-facing language. All eight sentences have a distinct intended response and explicit restrained TTS direction; fictional later outcomes remain withheld. This is editorial review, not audience testing or rendered-audio approval.

sentenceIntentions.text: An answer can make perfect sense and still leave your real problem out.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Make a coherent answer fail the actual problem

sentenceIntentions.text: Cones of Meaning explores how ideas make some questions visible and others difficult to ask.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the book's focus on visible and excluded questions
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand the meaning of its central metaphor

sentenceIntentions.text: AI gives this familiar problem new urgency by producing plausible explanations faster than people can examine them.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Connect generated plausibility to limited examination time
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel why the problem has become urgent

sentenceIntentions.text: The book follows scientific ideas, shared stories, and the institutions that make those stories powerful.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Follow concepts into culture and institutional authority
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Expect the metaphor to move across domains

sentenceIntentions.text: It asks what changes when a technical insight becomes a metaphor everyone starts repeating.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Ask how a technical insight changes when widely repeated
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Notice the journey from bounded result to common explanation

sentenceIntentions.text: A comparison can help us see something new while making it sound more certain than it is.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Show analogy opening attention while borrowing certainty
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Remain interested without mistaking metaphor for proof

sentenceIntentions.text: Confident explanations become more interesting when you can see how they direct your attention.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Bring confident explanations into the reader's experience
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to inspect how understanding is organized

sentenceIntentions.text: Begin with an answer that seems clear, and ask what it leaves outside the picture.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Point to the frame around the answer
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Wonder what an elegant explanation asks them to ignore
